title: Home Never Counted Her Bites
north_star: A soft illustrated archive of Aachu and Zuv's love, chaos, culture, and tiny rituals.

golden_theme_contract.first_principles_rule: Before submitting or scoring any new carousel idea, use these source files as the first-principles explanation of why the gold carousel worked: universal anti-ideal -> concrete Aachu proof -> Zuv steady response -> tender acceptance thesis.
golden_theme_contract.rule: Every carousel must start from a universal relationship truth, then prove it through Aachu/Zuv specifics. Photos, places, outfits, and objects are evidence, not the premise.
hard_fail_if: The concept is primarily about an object, outfit, location, or photo aesthetic.
A stranger could not send the carousel to a partner without knowing the private photo context.
Aachu's expressive role is missing or mocked.
Zuv's calm role is passive, absent, or treated as background.
The concept is mostly about taking photos, looking beautiful, glowing, or waiting for one more picture without a deeper relationship tension.
One partner's role is only looking good while the other waits or holds things.
The final thesis is generic romance without a concrete proof trail.
default_five_slide_map: Universal hook: one swipe-stopping relationship truth.
Aachu-specific reveal: her version of the truth.
Concrete proof: a drawable behavior, object, or ritual from the reference material.
Zuv role: what his calm, patience, care, or choice does emotionally.
Save/share thesis: the tender truth underneath the joke.
caption_formula: Open with the universal relationship truth.
Show the couple-specific behavior, care, posture, object, or rhythm in the middle; name Aachu/Zuv only when natural.
End with a soft send/save-worthy thesis.

human_truth: The right love turns food from calculation into comfort and appetite-for-life, so the final line becomes a mischievous receipt for a life that got more loved instead of a unsafe body-commentary joke.
emotional_arc: bas-thoda-sa hook -> home-never-counted setup -> best-bite proof -> food becomes comfort, not calculation -> life-zyada-tasty thesis
source_story_summary: She stopped saying, "bas thoda sa." Home never counted her bites. He saved the best one for her. Food became comfort, not calculation. Food was only proof. Bas life zyada tasty ho gayi.
visual_style: Create a complete publishable @a.storyof.two social slide in the established Aachu/Zuv illustrated carousel look: soft hand-drawn flat vector warmth with desi storybook texture. Treat the first supplied style references as canonical character-model sheets: preserve the same recurring caricature faces, proportions, hair shapes, expressive eyes, beard/brow structure, handwritten lettering, warm paper texture, and soft desi storybook linework from the accepted earlier carousels. Use Product Unshipped-like simplicity adapted for a desi love story, but do not reinterpret the couple into a new generic illustration style. Use the provided identity and style references to create recurring illustrated versions of Aachu/Anchal and Zuv/Himanshu, not generic stock characters. Keep warm off-white paper, imperfect black outlines, slightly uneven strokes, matte muted colors, generous breathing room, expressive faces, detailed-but-soft Indian outfits when story-relevant, and one clear visual idea. Minimalism must still feel alive: keep a few tiny innocent micro-elements such as small hearts, blush marks, reaction ticks, tiny motion lines, soft thought/reaction bubbles, or one small care detail when they support the emotional beat. Render the exact slide copy as handwritten-style black text inside the artwork, and add the tiny low-contrast handwritten brandmark '@a.storyof.two' at bottom-right as part of the generated image.
target_voice: Aachu/Zuv archive voice: warm, specific, playful underneath the tenderness

candidates.name: Home Never Counted Her Bites
candidates.universal_truth: The right love turns food from calculation into comfort, so enjoying life stops feeling like something to negotiate.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu stops guarding every bite with 'bas thoda sa' and lets her appetite become playful, visible, and loved.
candidates.concrete_proof: A home kitchen counter, a shared couch plate, and Zuv saving the best bite for her before she asks.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv makes comfort active by never counting, never teasing the number, and quietly keeping the best bite for her.
candidates.tender_thesis: Food was only proof. Bas life zyada tasty ho gayi.

candidates.name: The Best Bite Was A Promise
candidates.universal_truth: Sometimes care is the person who saves the best part for you without making you ask.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu's 'bas thoda sa' begins as guardedness and turns into comfortable mischief.
candidates.concrete_proof: The best bite stays on Zuv's side of the plate only until he slides it toward her.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv protects the softness by making her wanting more feel normal.
candidates.tender_thesis: Love makes one more bite feel safe.

candidates.name: Food Became Comfort, Not Calculation
candidates.universal_truth: The softest home is the one where appetite is not audited.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu stops making every bite sound small and starts letting the room see her ease.
candidates.concrete_proof: Kitchen snacks, couch laughter, and one shared plate with no invisible scorecard.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv removes the calculation by responding with care instead of commentary.
candidates.tender_thesis: Maybe love is a home that does not count.

candidates.name: She Stopped Eating Carefully
candidates.universal_truth: Some love does not change your body first; it changes how carefully you feel you have to live.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu's guarded 'bas thoda sa' softens into laughter, extra bites, and more room to exist.
candidates.concrete_proof: The same home table moves from tiny portion to shared snack spread.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv makes the shift safe by offering, saving, and sharing without making it a topic.
candidates.tender_thesis: The life got bigger because the love got safer.

candidates.name: Bas Thoda Sa Was A Shield
candidates.universal_truth: Sometimes 'just a little' is not appetite; it is a person trying not to be watched.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu's small phrase reveals the guardedness that home slowly dissolves.
candidates.concrete_proof: A half portion, a shared plate, and the best bite placed gently in front of her.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv gives her privacy inside love: no counting, no public teasing, no correction.
